offline_catalogue_comparison.interpretation: All five saved-track CRCs, including both audio tracks, and the aggregate saved lengths agree with this independent TOSEC entry. The console UI did not make this comparison. The report omits individual track lengths, so strict per-track size-plus-CRC matching is not asserted. No additional whole-file reread is needed to establish the recorded CRC comparison.
